items.description: Led the migration of an internal system from Flutter to Next.js, resulting in a ~40% improvement in performance and scalability.
Developed cross-platform internal apps using Flutter for iOS, Android, and Web, unifying codebase and reducing maintenance cost.
Built a reusable component library based on MUI, and created a project template with integrated authentication (NextAuth).
Designed and implemented a consistent and scalable design system by integrating MUI themes with designers in Figma.
Introduced Cypress to perform E2E tests on key user flows, raising test coverage.
Utilized Tolgee for i18n support, enabling product localization and easier language management across teams.
Built a user-specific analytics dashboard using ApexCharts and React, helping product managers gain insights into real-time data.
Created RESTful APIs using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic, focusing on performance with async operations and robust validation.
Containerized services using Docker and Docker Compose, simplifying local development and deployment pipelines.
Integrated Cerbos for fine-grained access control, implementing both RBAC and ABAC policies.
Wrote unit and integration tests with pytest, ensuring backend stability and system correctness.
Collaborated on the development of new features for Lasso.
Delivered enhancements aligned with business goals in a fast-paced Agile environment.
Applied Vue2 in the development of the merchant system, enhancing the frontend capabilities.
Contributed to the internal system development using PHP, focusing on robust and scalable solutions.
Designed and implemented APIs to facilitate seamless communication between the frontend and backend systems.
Created reusable components using Vue2 and React, promoting code reuse and consistency across projects.
Updated the testing database by restoring snapshots using AWS RDS, ensuring data integrity and availability.
